PlayerSatisfaction.subtitle: Per-game player reviews and app-store reviews — two sources, same category.
PlayerSatisfaction.caveat: This dataset doesn't cover the 11 facility-specific feedback attributes requested in the Leadership report — today it only resolves field quality. The rest of those attributes are still pending a decision on how to collect them.

tags.title: Most mentioned tags
tags.subtitle: Each review can carry more than one tag — percentages don't add up to 100.

fieldQuality.title: Field quality by facility
fieldQuality.subtitle: Sorted by % of reviews flagging a field problem, worst to best — the only one of the PDF's 11 facility-feedback attributes this dataset resolves today. Facilities with at least {min} reviews only.
fieldQuality.empty: No facility has enough reviews yet.

Forecast.subtitle: What to expect across the network (or the chosen filter) for the coming days, based on recent historical trend — an estimate with a margin of error, not games already scheduled.
Forecast.disclaimer: Estimate from linear regression over comparable historical blocks ({n} of the last {lookback} available) — not real data or games already scheduled. Each metric's range shows the margin of error (±1 historical standard deviation).
Forecast.methodAverage: Not enough history to estimate a trend — used the simple average of the last {n} comparable blocks.
Forecast.methodInsufficient: Not enough comparable history for this filter and range (at least {min} blocks needed, {n} available).

revenue.label: Revenue expected
revenue.lowConfidence: Lower confidence: combines price, players and volume, all three uncertain.

yoy.value: Same period, last year: {games} games · {pct} confirmation (real data, not projected).

risk.title: Facilities to watch
risk.subtitle: Own trend projected forward ({range}) — only the ones showing signs of decline.
risk.empty: No facility in this filter shows a projected declining trend.

regression.def: fits a trend line over the comparable historical blocks and projects one step forward — not a flat average, it reflects whether the metric has been trending up or down.

range.def: ± 1 standard deviation of those same historical blocks — the more irregular the history, the wider the range.

risk.def: facilities whose own recent trend, projected forward, worsens — same ranking criteria as Daily's risk radar, but looking forward instead of back.

insights.insufficient: Not enough comparable history to estimate with this filter (at least {min} blocks needed, {n} available).
insights.average: Not enough history to estimate a trend — used the simple average of the last {n} blocks.
insights.gamesUp: Expected volume has been growing: ~{n} games.
insights.gamesDown: Expected volume has been dropping: ~{n} games.
insights.yoyUp: Expected volume is {pct}% above what actually happened in the same period last year.
insights.yoyDown: Expected volume is {pct}% below what actually happened in the same period last year.
insights.riskTop: {n} facilities show a projected declining trend — the most pronounced is {name}.
insights.revenueCaveat: Expected revenue is the least reliable number in this forecast: it combines price, players and volume, all three uncertain.

Seasonality.subtitle: Annual volume and revenue evolution across the whole network (or the selected filter), month by month, compared against the prior year.

chart.empty: No confirmed games in this filter for these two years.

yoy.def: compares each month against the same month of the prior year — not the previous month — to isolate the business's own seasonality.

revenue.def: simple sum of the revenue logged per confirmed game, with no cost deducted — not profit or margin.

currentMonth.def: still in progress: its value and variation are partial and may rise before the month closes.

historicalPattern.def: unlike the rest of this page (which looks at one year at a time), this aggregates all available history by calendar month — useful for seeing which months are structurally stronger or weaker, beyond any single year.

insights.bestMonth: {month} was the highest-volume month of {year} ({n} games).
insights.currentMonthCaveat: {month} is still in progress: its value is partial, not the month's final close.
insights.noPriorYearData: No confirmed games in {priorYear} for this filter — no year-over-year baseline yet.
insights.revenueCaveat: The revenue shown is the simple sum logged per game, with no cost deducted.
insights.nextMonthVolumeUp: Based on the same stretch last year, {month} tends to run ~{pct}% higher in volume than the current month.
insights.nextMonthVolumeDown: Based on the same stretch last year, {month} tends to run ~{pct}% lower in volume than the current month.
insights.nextMonthGamesLow: Last year, {month} had the lowest confirmed-game volume of the whole year — worth anticipating.
insights.nextMonthGamesHigh: Last year, {month} had the highest confirmed-game volume of the whole year.
insights.nextMonthRevenueLow: Last year, {month} had the lowest revenue level of the whole year.
insights.nextMonthRevenueHigh: Last year, {month} had the highest revenue level of the whole year.

projection.title: {month} projection
projection.basedOn: Based on {confirmed} confirmed in {elapsed} of {total} days · variation vs. full prior month

historicalPattern.title: Historical pattern by month (all years)
historicalPattern.subtitle: Aggregates ALL available history by calendar month, across every year — answers "is January always slower, regardless of the year?", unlike the chart above, which compares one specific year against the previous one.
historicalPattern.bestWorst: {bestMonth} is historically the month with the highest {metric} ({bestValue}); {worstMonth} has the lowest ({worstValue}).

Reports.title: Reports
Reports.printHint: Opens the browser's print dialog — choose "Save as PDF" to download it.

breakdown.title: Comparison vs. prior period
breakdown.empty: Not enough data for this comparison.

seasonal.volumeUp: Based on the same stretch last year, the following period showed a ~{pct}% rise in confirmed volume.
seasonal.volumeDown: Based on the same stretch last year, the following period showed a ~{pct}% drop in confirmed volume.

actions.title: Suggested actions & focus for the next period
actions.seasonalUp: Anticipate a possible volume increase (~{pct}%), based on last year's pattern for this same stretch.
actions.seasonalDown: Anticipate a possible volume drop (~{pct}%), based on last year's pattern for this same stretch — don't treat it as a new problem if it plays out.
actions.cancellationTrendUp: The cancellation rate has been rising for {periods} consecutive periods (~{pts} points per period) — worth focusing on next period.
actions.cancellationHistoricalHigh: This is the highest cancellation rate in the last {periods} periods — worth prioritizing next period.
actions.volumeTrendDown: Confirmed games have been declining for {periods} consecutive periods — worth focusing on next period.
actions.volumeHistoricalLow: This is the lowest confirmed-games volume in the last {periods} periods.
actions.worstFacility: Review availability/operations at {facility}, the worst cancellation rate this period ({rate}%).
actions.monitorScope: Monitor {scope}: confirmed games fell {pct}% vs. the prior period.
actions.topReason: Review the dominant cancellation reason: {reason} ({pct}% of cancellations).
actions.empty: No specific suggestions for this period.

facilityFocus.title: This week's focus — by facility
facilityFocus.empty: No specific facilities to flag this period.

finding.volumeDrop: Dropped to {confirmedGames} confirmed games this week, {changePct}% fewer than the prior period.
finding.cancellationHigh: Cancellation rate of {rate}%, {gap} points above the network average ({networkRate}%).
finding.paretoShare: Accounts for {pct}% of all network cancellations this period ({count} games).

reason.dominant: {pct}% of its cancellations this week were due to "{reason}".

action.facilityIssue: Confirm with the facility whether the issue is still ongoing and, if so, get an estimated resolution date.
action.demand: Not an operational issue at the facility — review the demand/marketing strategy for that area.
action.weather: External cause (weather) — no action needed on the facility; confirm it doesn't repeat next week.
action.holiday: Expected dip due to a holiday — no action needed, monitor that it returns to its usual level.
action.reviewDemand: Not explained by cancellations — review whether booking demand dropped at that facility (marketing, competition, seasonality).
action.unclear: Contact the facility manager to find out the specific cause.

facilityFocus.tenureCaveat: Facility with less than 8 weeks of history in the network — some of this variation may be new-relationship noise rather than a real problem to solve.

opportunity.title: Opportunities to explore (unconfirmed)
opportunity.disclaimer: The pattern behind each finding may be 100% real, but there's no data confirming the suggested action is the most effective one — worth validating before rolling it out at scale.

peakWindow.finding: Over the last {periods} weeks, {pct}% of this facility's confirmed games ({confirmedInHour} of {totalConfirmed}) fell in the {hour} window, with a {confirmationRate}% confirmation rate in that slot vs. {facilityAvgRate}% overall for the facility — it concentrates most of its confirmed games and also confirms more often than its other time slots. Possible high-demand window; peak/off-peak isn't loaded in the facility profile yet.

option.secureSlots: Try pre-booking/securing those slots in advance.
option.addSimilarSlots: Try adding more similar slots (same day/time).
option.secondGame: Try a "second game" under the same conditions.
option.offPeakDiscount: Try offering a game outside that window at a lower price, to push confirmation/engagement.

unavailableSlot.finding: Over the last {days} days, the {hour} slot at this facility racked up {count} cancellations due to "Facility unavailable".

option.secureAdvance: Consider securing that slot in advance (or relocating it) while confirming whether the availability issue is still ongoing.

decliningSlot.finding: The {hour} slot has a {rate}% cancellation rate and has been losing confirmed games for {periods} consecutive periods — on top of cancelling a lot, it's losing traction.

option.discount: Consider offering a discount or lowering the price per player for that slot, to push confirmation and engagement.

evolution.title: Evolution — last {count} {granularity, select, week {weeks} month {months} other {periods}}

inventory.title: Published games by field, day and time
inventory.subtitle: Inventory = published offer (confirmed + cancelled) · {period}
inventory.note: A game is unique by field + day + time + format: Field 1 6v6 and Field 3 6v6 at the same time count separately. “Unidentified” = the source has no field name.

Inventory.title: Game inventory
Inventory.subtitle: Published supply in {scope} · {period}
Inventory.empty: No published games match these filters.
Inventory.emptyRated: No recurring game has at least {min} listings in this period; widen the range to sort by rate.

card.summary: {scheduled} published ({confirmed} conf. / {cancelled} canc.) · {players} of {capacity} players · avg price {price}
card.lowSample: Small sample (<{min}): the rate is not reliable.
card.unknownFieldNote: No field identifier: may mix different fields at the same day, time and format.

Inventory.truncated: The read cap was reached: older games in the range are missing. Narrow the period or filter.
Inventory.unknownFieldFootnote: {n} recurring games have no field identifier in the source data.
Inventory.definition: A recurring game = facility + day + time + field + format. Inventory = published supply (confirmed + cancelled). Fill = confirmed players / capacity, confirmed games only.
